info.title: MyGPT Local Git Workspace
info.description: Operate real Git repositories cloned on a private Linux server. Repository reads, searches and writes use the server's local filesystem. Project commands run inside a persistent per-repository OCI sandbox with the repository mounted read-write. Use these actions instead of built-in GitHub tools whenever possible.

post.summary: Clone or fetch a repository into the local server workspace
post.description: Call first when a repository is not local or when fresh remote state is needed. Existing dirty worktrees are fetched without overwriting local edits.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag or commit to check out when the worktree is clean

post.summary: Inspect local Git state and list repository files
post.description: Use this instead of GitHub repository browsing. Paginate with next_cursor until null when the file list is large.

200.description: Local repository state and file list

post.summary: Read multiple files directly from the local repository
post.description: Fast local filesystem read. Batch related files in one call. Text files return full content; binary files are identified without embedding binary data.
Uses ripgrep when available and never uses GitHub code search. Prefer this for finding symbols, strings and implementation locations.

post.summary: Walk the complete text repository under a response budget
post.description: For whole-repository analysis, repeatedly call this action with next_cursor until next_cursor is null. It reads local files only and can continue inside a large file.

post.summary: Write or delete files in the local repository
post.description: Changes the real local worktree immediately without using GitHub. Read relevant files first, then use gitDiff to verify edits before committing.

post.summary: Commit all local changes and push with native Git
post.description: Uses local git add/commit/push, not the GitHub REST API. The optional force flag maps to git push --force. GitHub repository rules remain authoritative.

branch.description: Optional branch to switch to or create before committing

post.summary: Run a project command inside the repository sandbox
post.description: Runs a shell command as root inside a persistent per-repository OCI container. The real repository is mounted read-write at /workspace, so build outputs and file edits persist. Package installs inside the sandbox persist across calls. The container does not receive host root filesystem, host devices, or the container-engine socket.

repo.description: Repository as owner/name; syncRepository must have cloned it first

command.description: Shell command to run inside the sandbox, for example: uname -m, apt-get update, npm test, go test ./..., python3 script.py

200.description: Command completed; inspect exit_code, stdout, stderr, timed_out and truncated
